preprocessing.compatibility: Temporary collections.abc import aliases; DAWG2 supplies dawg; local Punkt/cluster paths

mat2vec.pooling: Arithmetic mean of in-vocabulary token occurrences, then L2 normalization
mat2vec.unknown_tokens: Skipped, with occurrence-based coverage; all-OOV returns None

matscibert.preprocessing: Official normalize_text.py and vocab_mappings.txt, then checkpoint tokenizer
matscibert.pooling: Final-layer content-token mean, excluding padding/special tokens; then L2 normalization
matscibert.chunk_aggregation: Sum all content token states and divide by total content token count

combined_template: Nonempty labeled fields joined with newline, in input_fields order
invalid_vectors: Zero placeholders only; valid=False. Filter or explicitly handle before GP fitting.
